spanish: Y descendió Jehová en columna de nube, y se paró a abertura de la tienda, y llamó a Aarón y a Miryam, y salieron los dos de ellos.

findings.issue: Qal «stood» plus construct «opening of the tent» is smoothed as pronominal «se paró» plus preposition «a»; the construct head also lacks the Spanish article licensed by the definite tent.
findings.spanishSpan: se paró a abertura de la tienda

notes: Descent, pillar of cloud, call to Aarón and Miryam, and the two of them going out match the tokens.
